pages.quiz:
GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. It is seven o'clock in the evening and you arrive at a friend's house. What do you say? (1 mark)
   A. Guten Abend
   B. Gute Nacht
   C. Auf Wiedersehen
   D. Guten Morgen

2. Which sentence is used to say your name? (1 mark)
   A. Wie geht's?
   B. Auf Wiedersehen.
   C. Wie heißt du?
   D. Ich heiße Anna.

3. What does "die Dusche" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. living room
   B. pot
   C. cooker
   D. shower

4. What does "Welcher Tag ist heute?" ask? (1 mark)
   A. What is the weather today?
   B. Where is the school?
   C. Which day is it today?
   D. How old are you?

5. What number is "neun"? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 11
   C. 12
   D. 13

6. How is the letter D named in German? (1 mark)
   A. day
   B. kah
   C. tay
   D. yot

7. How is the letter P named in German? (1 mark)
   A. oo
   B. iks
   C. ess
   D. pay

8. How is the letter Z named in German? (1 mark)
   A. ay
   B. tset
   C. ell
   D. gay

9. Why do "Let's eat, Grandma" and "Let's eat Grandma" mean different things? (1 mark)
   A. The comma changes the meaning
   B. Only the capital letters differ
   C. One has more words
   D. One is in German

10. Which German name belongs to the mark "!"? (1 mark)
   A. das Fragezeichen
   B. der Punkt
   C. das Ausrufezeichen
   D. das Komma

11. What does "hinter dem Haus" mean? (1 mark)
   A. in front of the house
   B. on the house
   C. next to the house
   D. behind the house

12. What does "jetzt" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. often
   B. always
   C. now
   D. yesterday

13. Which day comes right before Donnerstag? (1 mark)
   A. Sonntag
   B. Freitag
   C. Dienstag
   D. Mittwoch

14. Which German word is the number 7? (1 mark)
   A. sieben
   B. achtzehn
   C. acht
   D. neun

15. Which German word is the number 2? (1 mark)
   A. drei
   B. zwei
   C. neunzehn
   D. achtzehn

16. What does "September" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. September
   B. February
   C. August
   D. December

17. What does "Zum Frühstück esse ich Brot" mean? (1 mark)
   A. For lunch I eat bread
   B. For breakfast I eat bread
   C. I sell bread
   D. I bake bread

18. Which body part do we link with "hören"? (1 mark)
   A. das Auge
   B. die Hand
   C. die Nase
   D. das Ohr

19. What is the plural of "das Ohr"? (1 mark)
   A. die Ohrer
   B. die Ohre
   C. die Ohren
   D. die Ohrs

20. What does "kalt" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. cold
   B. hot
   C. sunny
   D. cool

21. What does "neben" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. next to
   B. in front of
   C. under
   D. on

22. What does "lustig" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. hard-working
   B. old
   C. funny
   D. young

23. Which German word or phrase means "window"? (1 mark)
   A. die Uhr
   B. der Herd
   C. das Fenster
   D. das Haus

24. Which little word goes with the noun "Teller"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. das
   C. den
   D. der

25. What does "lesen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to speak
   B. to have a shower
   C. to read
   D. to drink

26. Which German word or phrase means "Sunday"? (1 mark)
   A. der Tag
   B. der Donnerstag
   C. der Montag
   D. der Sonntag

27. Which German word or phrase means "breakfast"? (1 mark)
   A. die Banane
   B. der Mais
   C. das Frühstück
   D. der Kohl

28. What is the plural of "die Hand"? (1 mark)
   A. die Hander
   B. die Hands
   C. die Hande
   D. die Hände

29. Which German word or phrase means "knee"? (1 mark)
   A. das Knie
   B. der Bauch
   C. das Ohr
   D. der Zahn

30. What does "nass" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. hot
   B. cold
   C. wet
   D. foggy

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Read: "Der Herd ist heiß. Das Messer ist scharf." Explain what the text warns about. (2 marks)

32. Say what "Zum Frühstück trinke ich Tee" means in English. (2 marks)

33. Write the German words with der, die or das for: knee, garden. (2 marks)

34. Write the German words with der, die or das for: garden, room, sun, thunderstorm. (4 marks)

35. Write the four punctuation marks with their German names. (4 marks)

36. Explain how a Rückendiktat is done. (3 marks)

37. Write the German words with der, die or das for: leg, house. (2 marks)

38. Unscramble the letters TAGFIRE to make a day of the week. (2 marks)

39. Read: "In Mombasa ist es heiß." Say what it means and how to say heiß. (2 marks)

40. Write three sentences about what you do on three different days. Start each with "Am". (3 marks)

41. Explain when we use dem and when we use der after a position word like auf or neben. (3 marks)

42. Write the German words with der, die or das for: radio, nose, family. (3 marks)

43. Write the singular and plural of Fuß in German. (2 marks)

44. Write the plural of Fuß, Zahn and Auge. (3 marks)

45. Write the German for: I cook, I sleep, I read, I play. (4 marks)

46. Write the German words with their articles for: kitchen, bedroom, garden, living room. (4 marks)

47. Write the German words with der, die or das for: cupboard or wardrobe, weather, back. (3 marks)

48. Write in German: "The lamp is next to the bed." (2 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #10 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Guten Abend
   Abend means evening. Gute Nacht is only for going to bed and Auf Wiedersehen is for leaving.

2. D — Ich heiße Anna.
   Ich heiße ... means My name is ...

3. D — shower
   die Dusche means shower.

4. C — Which day is it today?
   Welcher Tag means which day and heute means today.

5. A — 9
   neun is the number 9.

6. A — day
   In German the letter D is called day.

7. D — pay
   In German the letter P is called pay.

8. B — tset
   In German the letter Z is called tset.

9. A — The comma changes the meaning
   A comma shows a pause and can change the meaning of a sentence.

10. C — das Ausrufezeichen
   ! is the exclamation mark, das Ausrufezeichen.

11. D — behind the house
   hinter means behind.

12. C — now
   jetzt means now.

13. D — Mittwoch
   Before Donnerstag comes Mittwoch.

14. A — sieben
   7 in German is sieben.

15. B — zwei
   2 in German is zwei.

16. A — September
   September means September.

17. B — For breakfast I eat bread
   Frühstück is breakfast.

18. D — das Ohr
   We hear with the ears.

19. C — die Ohren
   The plural of das Ohr is die Ohren.

20. A — cold
   kalt means cold.

21. A — next to
   neben means next to.

22. C — funny
   lustig means funny.

23. C — das Fenster
   window in German is das Fenster.

24. D — der
   It is der Teller, so the little word is der.

25. C — to read
   lesen means to read.

26. D — der Sonntag
   Sunday in German is der Sonntag.

27. C — das Frühstück
   breakfast in German is das Frühstück.

28. D — die Hände
   The plural of die Hand is die Hände.

29. A — das Knie
   knee in German is das Knie.

30. C — wet
   nass means wet.

SECTION B
----
31. (2 marks)
   Answer: The cooker is hot and the knife is sharp, so we must be careful in the kitchen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each warning.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: For breakfast I drink tea.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for breakfast, 1 mark for drink tea.

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: das Knie, der Garten.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

34. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Garten, das Zimmer, die Sonne, das Gewitter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

35. (4 marks)
   Answer: . der Punkt, , das Komma, ? das Fragezeichen, ! das Ausrufezeichen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each mark with its name.

36. (3 marks)
   Answer: A partner traces letters on your back; you say the letters aloud and write the word.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the steps: tracing, saying, writing.

37. (2 marks)
   Answer: das Bein, das Haus.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

38. (2 marks)
   Answer: Freitag.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the correct word and 1 mark for the capital letter.

39. (2 marks)
   Answer: In Mombasa it is hot. heiß is said like hice.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

40. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Am Montag gehe ich zur Schule. Am Samstag spiele ich Fußball. Am Sonntag gehe ich in die Kirche.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence with a capital letter, verb in second place and a full stop.

41. (3 marks)
   Answer: dem with der and das nouns (dem Tisch, dem Bett) and der with die nouns (der Tür).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for dem with der nouns, 1 mark for dem with das nouns, 1 mark for der with die nouns.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: das Radio, die Nase, die Familie.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Fuß, die Füße.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each form.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: die Füße, die Zähne, die Augen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct plural.

45. (4 marks)
   Answer: Ich koche, ich schlafe, ich lese, ich spiele.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

46. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Küche, das Schlafzimmer, der Garten, das Wohnzimmer.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with its article.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Schrank, das Wetter, der Rücken.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: Die Lampe ist neben dem Bett.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the sentence pattern and 1 mark for neben dem Bett.
